description: NaBaPO₄ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pnma space group. Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.51-2.85 Å. Ba is bonded in a 9-coordinate geometry to nine O atoms. There are a spread of Ba-O bond distances ranging from 2.70-3.01 Å. P is bonded in a tetrahedral geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.55-1.57 Å. There are three inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to one Na, two equivalent Ba, and one P atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to one Na, three equivalent Ba, and one P atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to two equivalent Na, two equivalent Ba, and one P atom.
